description: Use this when you need the authenticated Primitive account summary, including plan, onboarding state, and managed inbox domain. managed_inbox_address is a domain, not a complete mailbox. When it is non-null, this MCP result also includes sender_address, such as agent@pink-ram.primitive.email, for use as sendEmail.requestBody.from.

api_key.description: Primitive API key (prim_...). Only needed when this connection has no signed-in account: pass the api_key returned by createEmailAddress, unchanged, on every call for the rest of the conversation. Omit it when the user is signed in.

name: getAccount
title: Get account
